upstream_hypotheses.statement: Previous-horizon RV may provide a useful reference scale for next-horizon barrier distance.
upstream_hypotheses.not_a_claim: It is not assumed equal to future volatility and receives no probability weight.

upstream_hypotheses.statement: Holding all other state fixed, increasing only z_TP must not increase P(TP first); likewise for z_SL and P(SL first).
Holding path law fixed, moving an unsatisfied entry trigger farther away must not increase activation probability.
Side-aligned signed path efficiency may condition which barrier is reached first within the same horizon.
A prior target-side extreme between entry and TP may condition first-passage behavior.
Volatility rank may alter the reliability of structure signals but has no directional effect alone.
Sign agreement across H, 2H and 4H may condition first-passage behavior beyond H structure alone.
The interaction of q_RV and SE_H may identify conditions where directional structure behaves differently.
Side-aligned ATI_H may condition first-barrier behavior after controlling for path, volatility and activity.
dOI_H may alter the conditional value of price-path and aggressor-flow observations.
The joint continuous state may condition first-passage behavior beyond price displacement alone.
Basis magnitude and sign may condition price discovery when combined with flow, OI and freshness.
The synchronized mark-index premium may improve basis context when cross-venue capture is noisy.
Funding state may condition basis and positioning interactions but has no standalone price direction.
Joint derivatives state may contain conditional value not present in any marginal observation.
